exceptions.oracle_expectation: Regenerate target creature: castable proactively, creating a shield that replaces the next destruction this turn.
exceptions.shandalar_behavior: The handler requires TARGET_STATE_DESTROYED, so only a creature already being destroyed is an eligible target. There were no proactive shields before the Sixth Edition rules changes; regeneration was used at destruction time in the damage-prevention window.
exceptions.pending: The active cases cover legacy main-phase rejections. data/pending_cases/cards/000/00057-death-ward.json is an excluded modern-rule shield reference, not a destruction-window scenario. Legacy regeneration success during destruction remains untested.

exceptions.oracle_expectation: {B}: Regenerate this creature at any time, creating a shield for later destruction.
exceptions.shandalar_behavior: The shared regeneration helper gates activation on the LCBP_REGENERATION window flag, which is only set while the engine prompts for regeneration effects during destruction. Main-phase activation is correctly rejected under pre-Sixth Edition timing, where regeneration could only be used at destruction time.
exceptions.pending: The host can now script destruction-window activation with choose_priority. This card still lacks a successful destruction-window case; batch 11 covers that shared path through Uthden Troll, Wall of Bone, Wall of Brambles, and Will-o'-the-Wisp.

exceptions.oracle_expectation: {R}: Regenerate this creature. Modern regeneration may be activated proactively to create a replacement shield.
exceptions.shandalar_behavior: Use regeneration during the destruction window, after the creature has been marked for destruction. Main-phase shield activation is rejected under the same intentional legacy timing documented for Drudge Skeletons. Regeneration still replaces destruction, taps the creature, heals its damage, and removes it from combat; the new cases exercise those effects through normal engine decisions.
exceptions.pending: This batch covers destruction and lethal-combat windows. Turn-to-turn regeneration availability and regeneration prohibition remain separate coverage.
